canonical_path_selection.rule: A route is on main when some Plans/ blob at the base has exactly its sha256 (Plans/_shards and Plans/.plan_index excluded). Among equal-byte paths the alias of the original component prefix wins (canon's original_source_text_aliases pattern), then a primary path outside preinstallation-originals/, predecessor/ and inputs/, then the first path.

explicit_cross_realm_edges.rule: Exact missing original edge only; nested resolution remains in the target realm; no merged realms, rewritten strings, namespace copies, network or host filesystem retrieval

rule: Original prose and file-relative references resolve from their exact original document location (original source root plus relative path) through this complete route table only: to the named Plans/ path whose bytes at the base equal the route's sha256, or to the named member of the external v3 source package cited by its manifest token and the member sha256. Basenames, latest versions, same-ID replacement, host lookup and prefix inference are forbidden. Historical coordinates identify lineage and never choose current registration; active roots and methods resolve only through resource-realms.json and method-root-bindings.json. An original relative path and an external member path are written exactly as the external edition's manifest lists them; they are lineage coordinates, never renamed.
